sections.title: Gramática
sections.explanation: El present perfect continuous destaca la duración o el proceso; el present perfect simple, el resultado o el número de acciones completadas.

Not only did she arrive early, but she also helped.

title: Síntesis B2 y Use of English
objective: Combinar precisión léxica, transformaciones y argumentación.

sections.title: Vocabulario
sections.explanation: Aprende las palabras y expresiones necesarias para síntesis b2 y use of english. Escucha, repite y úsalas en frases propias.

sections.title: Gramática
sections.explanation: Las key word transformations conservan el significado y usan la palabra dada sin modificarla. Revisa tiempo verbal, voz, preposición y número de palabras.
sections.form: sentence A → key word → equivalent sentence B
examples: The journey was too long for us. → ENOUGH → We did not have enough time for the journey.
I started work in 2021. → BEEN → I have been working since 2021.

sections.title: Phrasal verbs y verbos con partícula
sections.explanation: Aprende el significado completo de cada expresión: la partícula puede cambiar el sentido del verbo. Practica la expresión dentro de una frase.

sections.title: Listening
sections.explanation: Escucha el audio dos veces. Primero identifica la idea principal; después busca los datos concretos.
sections.script: The speaker argues that public libraries remain valuable even when many books are available online. She accepts that digital access is convenient, but points out that libraries also offer quiet study space and staff support. In her view, funding should prioritise flexible spaces rather than simply buying more shelves.

sections.title: Speaking
sections.explanation: Responde en voz alta. Da información pertinente y añade un detalle o razón cuando puedas.
prompts: B2 First, turno individual: Compare two photographs and speculate about the people’s reasons for their choices.

sections.title: Reading
sections.explanation: Lee el texto y responde según la información que aparece, sin suponer datos externos.
sections.text: A review of a new science museum praised its hands-on exhibits and clear explanations. The writer thought older visitors would appreciate the historical section, while younger children might prefer the interactive laboratory. However, the reviewer found the ticket price rather high and suggested a reduced family rate.
